Source: HubSpot TAM export (usa-tam-relevant.csv). Companies = distinct Org IDs; Rooftops = distinct Company IDs, each mapped to the state on its row (deduplicated to one row per rooftop). Lifecycle stage comes from Lifecycle Stage (GD Level), the only stage field in this data pull — Companies and Rooftops are two ways of counting the same set of rooftops (by parent org vs. by individual dealership record), not two different stage sources. Map shading = companies by stage. Filters (HubSpot Team & Lifecycle Stage) drive the map, panel and account list.

Source: live Spyne accounts sheet. Companies = distinct enterprise accounts, Rooftops = distinct rooftop rows (a rooftop live on two products counts twice). State is derived from each rooftop's coordinates, not the free-text state field, so it renders reliably even where that field was typed inconsistently. Rooftops outside the 50 states + DC (mostly international) are excluded from the map and state table but counted above.
